summary: MSVC exception-frame teardown helper (__thiscall): runs the standard MSVC exception destructor on the exception object, then conditionally frees the object when the flag bit is set, and returns the object pointer. Used on the compiler-generated exception cleanup path.

operations.description: Invoke MSVCExceptionDestructor(this) to run the standard MSVC exception teardown on the object.
Test flag bit (a2 & 1) != 0 to decide whether the object must be freed after destruction.
When the flag bit is set, call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the exception object's allocation.
Return the object pointer `this` unchanged, matching the MSVC destructor wrapper convention.
